summary: The Republic of Bashkortostan stands under Russia's national framework, which the Russia record carries. The same is true of the US State Department travel advisory for Russia, which gives country-wide guidance only.

outOfScopeNotes: Whether authorities in Bashkortostan enforce the national propaganda and extremism provisions at a different rate from the rest of Russia is unresolved; the inventory documents no republic-level policing, custody practice, venue enforcement or healthcare provision.
